Title: Video Indexer is now ISO, SOC, HiTRUST, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI certified

Body.Content:
We’re committed to help our customers meet their own compliance obligations across regulated industries and markets worldwide. Today, we are excited to announce that Video Indexer is ISO 27001, ISO 27018, SOC 1,2,3, HIPAA, FedRAMP, HITRUST and PCI certified. Please refer here to see the full certification status of Video Indexer along with all other Azure services.  

Azure maintains the largest compliance portfolio in the industry both in terms of breadth (total number of offerings), as well as depth (number of customer-facing services in assessment scope), and we are proud to be part of the most trusted cloud in the world! 

Have questions or feedback on Video Indexer? We would love to hear from you! Use our UserVoice to help us prioritize features, or email VISupport@Microsoft.com for any questions. 

Learn more
